recommendation: Keep this audit commit as the durable disposition for the duplicate ownership request. Revisit only if DocumentManifest is restored to the active build; otherwise continue pointing implementers to List.
issue_request: FHIR-24896 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked that DocumentManifest, like DocumentReference, be owned by OO; the Jira resolution says the change had already been made for R5.
initial_application: No source commit mentioning FHIR-24896 was found. The same requested change was explicitly applied by fc106b11d6fb17ca165ad6f4144cb48544c2461a for FHIR-37854, changing source/fhir.ini from documentmanifest=sd to documentmanifest=oo.
additional_context: OO minutes on 2022-08-30 recorded that FHIR-24896 and FHIR-37854 both asked for this already-applied ownership change. FHIR-24896 also anticipated moving away from DocumentManifest toward List, and current source/history reflects that later removal.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the active mapping was already changed to OO before DocumentManifest was removed, and there is no active current-build DocumentManifest entry to edit.
